q1_arm_calibration.fit: 3x3 homogeneous affine least squares for XY; separate least-squares plane for contact Z
q1_arm_calibration.source: User tip-down corner measurements 2026-07-31 evening; q1/config/robot_config.json
q1_arm_calibration.note: XY residual ~4 mm RMS is dominated by non-affine corner inconsistency (+/-4 mm in robot X). Z plane residual is 0.25 mm RMS. pick_height/release_height stay absolute at the paper-center reference and follow the plane elsewhere. Physical pick/place with this matrix is still pending.

q1_target_geometry.source: docs/E题_拼图装置.pdf page 2 Figure 2; run 20260731_012300_357937 scene/piece_moves JSON
q1_target_geometry.note: 1.03 only calibrates the current fixed Q1 four-piece set. edge_gap_mm=2 shifts each piece 1 mm radially outward from the centered target; it does not redefine the official Figure 2 dimensions or apply to field-provided pieces.

q1_pick_point.method: maximum-clearance interior point of the detected polygon at 0.25 mm raster resolution
q1_pick_point.source: runs 20260730_232827_207582, 20260730_233201_481210 and 20260730_233351_970591; q1/geometry.py::polygon_maximum_clearance_point; reset with 2026-07-31 evening corner recalibration
q1_pick_point.note: Across the three runs P4 boundary clearance changes from 0.45..2.12 mm at the old detected center to 19.77..20.48 mm. Pickup XY bias was cleared when the corner matrix was refit; reintroduce only after a new physical miss.

q1_transfer_trajectory.roll_policy: Lift at pickup XY with pick roll, then rotate in air at Z=120 to the compensated release roll. Rotation below 1 degree is skipped; otherwise duration=max(400, 1200*max(0.5, abs(normalized roll delta)/90)).
q1_transfer_trajectory.note: The fixed BUFFER and diagonal clearance are no longer in the production Q1 chain. All three recorded images replan successfully with the new poses, and Mock execution confirms magnet ON after descend_pick and OFF after descend_place. The physical trajectory remains to be verified.

q1_swing_roll_compensation.xy_source: final commanded robot pickup XY after the +5/+5 mm pickup correction, and unmodified commanded release XY
q1_swing_roll_compensation.note: All four pieces in runs 20260730_232827_207582, 20260730_233201_481210 and 20260730_233351_970591 replan successfully. Computed swing magnitudes span 25.156..52.757 degrees. The formula is source-confirmed; the -1 physical correction sign still requires one real Q1 placement check.

q1_partial_paper_detection.behavior: For the fixed landscape Q1 composition, detect_paper pairs the left and right dark halves, validates the narrow bright divider, and gives that full-width candidate priority over a single dark half. A clipped top or bottom edge is extrapolated from the visible 29.7 cm side using the fixed A4 aspect ratio.
q1_partial_paper_detection.note: The three clipped samples and run 20260730_211654_514549 produce paper_valid=true, scene_valid=true and P1..P4 in UPPER_SOURCE. The effective divider gap may be as narrow as max(2 px, 0.2% image width); brightness and paired-half geometry remain required.
